name: Packaged Pristine Pelts
summary: A traveler asks you to carry pristine pelts to her sisters in Stormwind. The delivery can reach them before she can return home.

sections.title: A Family Delivery
sections.body: The package of pristine pelts is meant for Kimberly Grant. She cannot return home for some time, and expects you to reach Stormwind first. Her sisters Kelly and Kimberly can usually be found in the Park.

faq.answer: A traveler asks you to deliver the pristine pelts to her sisters, Kelly and Kimberly.
The package is to be delivered to Kimberly Grant in Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can I find the sisters?
faq.answer: Kelly and Kimberly can usually be found in the Park in Stormwind.

faq.q: Why am I carrying the pelts?
faq.answer: The traveler cannot return to Stormwind for some time and asks you to bring the pelts to her sisters.
